## I. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

### 1.1 Executive Overview
This formal security audit assesses the technical vulnerabilities of **ELBuenFin.org** based on external security data sources including Qualys SSL Labs, Zium.co Security Review, siteTrends Apache stack identification, and vulnerability databases (NVD, CVE, Google Safe Browsing). 

The assessment identifies **seven (7)** distinct vulnerabilities affecting server infrastructure, cryptographic protocols, HTTP security headers, and JavaScript dependencies. Of these vulnerabilities:

| Severity Level | Count | % of Total | Timeline Requirement |
|----------------|-------|------------|---------------------|
| 🔴 **CRITICAL** | 2 | 28.6% | < 48 hours |
| 🟡 **HIGH** | 3 | 42.9% | < 72 hours |
| 🟢 **MEDIUM** | 2 | 28.6% | < 14 days |
